biggest_catch: You must REGISTER for the offer first (via the registration link on the promo page) before opening the account — skipping registration may forfeit the bonus.
catches: Must register for the offer (via the page's registration link) before opening; opening without registering may not count.
Within 60 days of account opening: complete at least 1 direct deposit, AND at least 12 debit card transactions (excluding ATM), AND enroll in eStatements.
Reward bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS.

Membership eligibility required (county list per aggregator reports — confirm current eligibility geography on fhfcu.org): Allegany, Chemung, Livingston, Schuyler, Steuben, Tioga, or Yates counties in NY, or Bradford, Lycoming, Potter, or Tioga counties in PA (per doctorofcredit eligibility summary).
Offer may be changed or withdrawn at any time — no stated end date.
Allow 30 days for the direct deposit of your reward bonus after completing all offer requirements.
The registration flow routes through ReferLive (a third-party referral platform) — review their communications preferences during registration.
